_README: TEMPORARY until Sparks sends worlds[].unlockHash. This file ships inside the build (extraResources) so real students get gated worlds before the admin has a code field. Keyed by packId then worldId, the value is sha256(code.trim().toLowerCase()) from `npm run lock-code -- "<code>"`. The worldId MUST match the manifest exactly - if Sparks renames a world, its code stops matching and the world shows open. Editing codes means rebuilding. The manifest's unlockHash wins over this the moment Sparks sends it, and a local <dataDir>/world-locks.json overrides this for testing without a rebuild.
